lessonRef.title: Performance task: build: the guide with estimates, units, and elapsed-time reasoning

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Set up the first two carefully; the rest of the build depends on them.

items.prompt: Practice starts at 3:00 p.m. and lasts 32 minutes. What time does practice end?
A container has 300 liters. 82 liters are removed. How many liters are left?

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Practice starts at 9:45 a.m. and lasts 85 minutes. What time does practice end?
A container has 261 milliliters. Another 152 milliliters are poured in. How many milliliters are in the container now?
Practice starts at 1:45 p.m. and lasts 132 minutes. What time does practice end?
A container has 283 liters. Another 196 liters are poured in. How many liters are in the container now?
Practice starts at 7:30 a.m. and lasts 101 minutes. What time does practice end?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Carry the build to a result and say how you would check it is right.

items.prompt: A container has 462 grams. Another 285 grams are poured in. How many grams are in the container now?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
